definitions: Each of a pair of globular organs in the head through which people and vertebrate animals see.
A thing resembling an eye in form or function, in particular a small hole or loop.
A dark spot on a potato from which a new shoot grows.
The calm centre of a storm or hurricane.
examples: He kept an eye on the children.
Cut out the eyes from the potatoes.
The ship was in the eye of the storm.
